notablePrerequisites:
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 4 or greater.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron, putting the creature card onto the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.
